units.source_text: 幸亏是周末除策（这是指除去警策①的意思，故如是说），

en.t: Fortunately, it was the weekend suspension of discipline, that is, the removal of the warning stick, as they called it,

units.source_text: 我到廉价的"三番馆"电影院看了一场电影，

en.t: so I went to the cheap Sanbankan movie theater and saw a film,

units.source_text: 归途独自漫步在久未踏足的新京极街上。

en.t: and on the way back I wandered alone along Shinkyogoku Street, where I had not set foot for a long time.

units.source_text: 在杂沓的人流中，迎面碰上一个熟悉的面孔，

en.t: In the jostling stream of people, I came face to face with someone familiar,

units.source_text: 没等我想起是谁的时候，这张脸已被人流推拥到我的身后去了。

en.t: but before I could remember who it was, that face had already been pushed past me by the crowd and swept behind me.
